notes: Assertions sample at clk edges, so off-edge output changes are detected by an event-driven monitor. It counts any output change whose time differs from the last posedge i_clk or negedge i_rst_n. The assertion then checks that the count did not grow during the previous cycle. This relies on Verilator running with --timing, and on DUT outputs updating via NBA, after the edge-time register is written. A violation is reported at the next clock edge, not in the time step where it happens. Violations during reset are not reported because disable iff is active.
